name: PT. AwanBit Data Indonesia
notes:
CloudBit | PT. AwanBit Data Indonesia
a high-growth Internet Service Provider (ISP) and infrastructure operator dedicated to accelerating digital connectivity across Indonesia’s emerging regional landscapes. We operate a robust, high-capacity unlimited fiber-optic network designed for low-latency delivery and maximum uptime.

As a strategic local alternative in the Indonesian digital ecosystem, CloudBit focuses on bridging regional gaps with carrier-grade infrastructure. We are committed to an open peering policy to enhance the local internet experience and optimize traffic exchange for our customers and partners.
